about: DAILY PIT (Dom 2026-10-28): one seeded boss fight a day with ONE chaos modifier, the same for everyone. The day is the UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD); the boss and the modifier are a pure hash of it (src/daily-pit.ts: hash32 of `salt|date|boss` and `salt|date|modifier`, modulo the lists below), so any two players on the same UTC day meet the same fight and the day rolls over at 00:00 UTC. `bosses`: the boss pool, data/profiles.json row ids of the WIRED roster bosses (the zone row's own spawns) whose body is CUTTABLE (a data/physics.json opponents row with a 106 measure and a manifest in src/fight/physics-chunk.ts cutManifests); a ring boss joins the day it is cuttable, by adding its id here (the validator checks the body). `spawnId`: the zone spawn the day's boss takes (data/zones/zone1.row.json; it is also data/respawn.json openers.spawns, so the fight opens by itself after the usual idle seconds); the daily zone is that one spawn and nothing else (no ring bosses, no other camp), with `respawnSeconds` so it never stands again. MODIFIERS: each row is a set of switches the existing systems already express, laid over the day's boss for that page view only: `tune` is a ?tune= multiplier (src/tune.ts: health = foeHealthScale, damage = every blow he lands, speed = his pace, each clamped by data/tune.json), merged OVER the page's tune with src/progression.ts mergeTune; `stars` is a data/stars.json level (0 = none, 1 or 2) the boss stands as, from the first frame. Nothing here is a new sim rule. THE DAILY IS THE SAME FOR EVERYONE: in a daily run the progression save is neither read nor written for the fight (no escalation, no unlocked weapon, no corpse run), so the boss and the hero are the shipped ones plus the day's modifier. ATTEMPTS: `attemptsPerDay` fights a day (an attempt is spent when the boss engages, so leaving mid-fight costs one); the count and the day's best live in the progression save (src/progression.ts Save.daily, optional: an old save loads without it). SCORE: a win scores `base` minus `perSecond` per second engaged, minus `perDamage` per hit point the hero lost, plus `perPart` per body part cut (the cut log, `cutLog` = data/physics.json cut.log, from the first blow to the result), held to `min`..`max`; a defeat scores 0. `resultDelaySeconds`: how long after the kill (won) or the fall (lost) the result screen waits, so the kill's ceremony and the cuts are seen first. `fields` is the order of the result lines. HOOKS (no share clip and no leaderboard here): `event` is the DOM CustomEvent name dispatched on window with the finished result (detail: date, boss, modifier, attempt, row, best, bestEver), the share clip lane listens to it; src/daily-pit.ts `onResult(fn)` is the same hook in code and the one place a Supabase leaderboard submit goes after online lands. `modeKey`: the sessionStorage key the Daily Pit button sets (value = the UTC date) before it reloads the page into the daily run: there is no URL flag. `later`: what Dom listed that no existing row can express yet, each with the missing piece; they join `modifiers` the day they can.

later.why: no gravity row: the ragdoll world has one fixed value (data/physics.json) and no per-run override
no fists weapon row in src/fight/weapon-defs.json; the hero draws only weapons that have art for his hand
the zone has no wall (open radius); the arena size is only the drawn floor (respawn.json world.pitScale), so it changes nothing about the fight
no start-health key: the hero's health is built by the sim (kindPractice); a start fraction is a new sim input
no head-scale row on the boss rigs (star scaleX scales the whole body only)
